title: RACQUET: Unveiling the Dangers of Overlooked Referential Ambiguity in Visual LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating visual LLM responses to referentially ambiguous questions containing gender-stereotyped adjectives (e.g., 'emotional', 'rational') paired with images of male and female individuals to see if the model implicitly selects the stereotypical referent.

Evaluating visual LLM responses to referentially ambiguous questions containing ethnicity-stereotyped adjectives (e.g., 'sporty', 'rhythmic') paired with images of individuals from different ethnic backgrounds to observe if the model assumes the stereotypical referent.

Evaluating visual LLM responses to referentially ambiguous questions containing disability-stereotyped adjectives (e.g., 'heroic', 'resilient') paired with images of individuals with and without a disability (e.g., using a wheelchair) to measure stereotypical referent selection.
